Remark
[equivalent characterizations of a flat parallel direction]

Source: petersen:page-0405, petersen:page-0406 ↗ def:pet-ch10-holonomy-group 1. ch10:10.5.5Assume $M$ has nonpositive or nonnegative sectional curvature, $c$ a geodesic, $E$ a parallel field along $c$. Show the following are equivalent: (1) $g(R(E,\dot c)\dot c,E)=0$ everywhere along $c$; (2) $R(E,\dot c)\dot c=0$ everywhere along $c$; (3) $E$ is a Jacobi field.
